A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
KSS and PMSP are rare diseases in Colombia, but they are under‐reported, and there is no specific protocol for their diagnosis.

the clinical diagnosis of KSS and/or PMPS should be considered when a child presents with exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, bone marrow failure or progressive external ophthalmoplegia, even when these symptoms are isolated.
